These '''insurgents''' were from the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Yag'Dhul/Legends|Yag'Dhul]]. In [[5 BBY/Legends|5 BBY]], they attracted the attention of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], which sent forces with the [[Imperial I-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Imperial I''-class Star Destroyer]] [[Desolator (Imperial-class)/Legends|''Desolator'']] to attack the insurgents. In the [[Battle of Yag'Dhul (Imperial era)|ensuing battle]], the insurgents were defeated, however, as the Imperials were distracted by a group of [[Gambling/Legends|gamblers]] who had been betting on the skirmish&mdash;the Imperials mistakenly believed them to have been supplying intelligence to the insurgents&mdash;they attacked the gamblers as well, allowing many of the insurgents' [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighters]] to escape into [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]].
